description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to leave type entitlement usage reports in an HR management system. It includes properties for various filter criteria such as leave type ID, job title ID, employee numbers, subunit ID, location ID, and inclusion options for employees. The class extends a date range filter and uses traits for subunit ID chain handling, with constants and getter/setter methods for each property.

classes.name: LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating search filter parameters for leave entitlement usage reports, including various filter criteria like leave type, job title, employee numbers, subunit, location, and employee inclusion options.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave type used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the job title used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getSubunitId
methods.description: Returns the subunit ID used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setSubunitId
methods.description: Sets the subunit ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Returns the location ID used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setLocationId

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the employee inclusion option for filtering (current, past, or both).
